docstring:
There exists some constant $c>0$ such that
$$R(C_4,K_n) \ll n^{2-c}.$$

The prize of $100 is offered in [Er78] for a proof or disproof.

This problem is #17 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection.
references: [Er78] Erdős, P., Problems and results in combinatorial analysis and combinatorial number theory. Proc. Ninth Southeastern Conf. Combinatorics, Graph Theory and Computing (1978), 29-40.
[Sp77] Spencer, J., Asymptotic lower bounds for Ramsey functions. Discrete Math. (1977), 69-76.
type_pretty:
∃ c,
  ∃ (_ : 0 < c),
    ∃ C,
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        1 ≤ n → ↑((SimpleGraph.cycleGraph 4).graphRamsey (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n))) ≤ C * ↑n ^ (2 - c)
